title: Slab two contracts to eight exact terminal boxes but remains globally open
next_gate: On the eight retained boxes, use a cancellation-preserving exact or interval Taylor model of the full Fisher objective and close all exposed faces and corners around the isolated slab-two boundary KKT point.
scope_guard: The eight boxes are an outer frontier, not eight competitors. Their survival prevents promotion of the local KKT certificate to a complete slab-two theorem.
